		VAR __Sync_Data = 
			SUBSTITUTEWITHINDEX(

		VAR __MinY_Value = MINX(KEEPFILTERS(__Sync_Data), [Value])

metrics.visualTitle: Heat Map: Monthly Sales by Region

metrics.QueryText:
DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		FILTER(
			KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('dCalendar'[Month Name])),
			NOT('dCalendar'[Month Name] IN {"out",
				"nov",
				"dez",
				"set"})
		)

	VAR __DS0FilterTable2 = 
		FILTER(
			KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('dCalendar'[CY | LY])),
			AND('dCalendar'[CY | LY] IN {"CY"}, 'dCalendar'[CY | LY] IN {"CY"})
		)

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			ROLLUPADDISSUBTOTAL(
				ROLLUPGROUP('dCalendar'[Month Name], 'dCalendar'[Month]), "IsGrandTotalRowTotal"
			),
			'dRegion'[Região],
			__DS0FilterTable,
			__DS0FilterTable2,
			"v__Faturamento", 'medidas'[$ Faturamento]
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(
			101,
			SUMMARIZE(__DS0Core, 'dCalendar'[Month Name], 'dCalendar'[Month], [IsGrandTotalRowTotal]),
			[IsGrandTotalRowTotal],
			1,
			'dCalendar'[Month],
			1,
			'dCalendar'[Month Name],
			1
		)

	VAR __DS0SecondaryBase = 
		SUMMARIZE(__DS0Core, 'dRegion'[Região])

	VAR __DS0Secondary = 
		TOPN(102, __DS0SecondaryBase, 'dRegion'[Região], 1)

	VAR __DS0BodyLimited = 
		NATURALLEFTOUTERJOIN(
			__DS0PrimaryWindowed,
			SUBSTITUTEWITHINDEX(
				__DS0Core,
				"ColumnIndex",
				__DS0Secondary,
				'dRegion'[Região],
				ASC
			)
		)

	VAR __DS0CoreNoInstanceFiltersNoTotals = 
		FILTER(KEEPFILTERS(__DS0Core), [IsGrandTotalRowTotal] = FALSE)

EVALUATE
	GROUPBY(
		__DS0CoreNoInstanceFiltersNoTotals,
		"Minv__Faturamento", MINX(CURRENTGROUP(), [v__Faturamento]),
		"Maxv__Faturamento", MAXX(CURRENTGROUP(), [v__Faturamento])
	)

EVALUATE
	__DS0Secondary

ORDER BY
	'dRegion'[Região]

EVALUATE
	__DS0BodyLimited

ORDER BY
	[IsGrandTotalRowTotal], 'dCalendar'[Month], 'dCalendar'[Month Name], [ColumnIndex]

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('fOrdemItem'[Recency Score], "Customers_RFM", 'medidas'[Customers RFM])

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(1001, __DS0Core, 'fOrdemItem'[Recency Score], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	'fOrdemItem'[Recency Score]

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('dFreq'[Frequency Score], "Frequency", 'medidas'[Frequency])

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(1001, __DS0Core, [Frequency], 0, 'dFreq'[Frequency Score], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	[Frequency] DESC, 'dFreq'[Frequency Score]

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		FILTER(
			KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('dCalendar'[M])),
			NOT('dCalendar'[M] IN {BLANK()})
		)

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('auxValor'[valor], __DS0FilterTable, "Customers_RFM", 'medidas'[Customers RFM])

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(1001, __DS0Core, [Customers_RFM], 0, 'auxValor'[valor], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	[Customers_RFM] DESC, 'auxValor'[valor]

EVALUATE
	ROW(
		"v__Faturamento_6M", 'medidas'[$ Faturamento 6M],
		"v__Faturamento_6M_sobre_Total", 'medidas'[% Faturamento 6M sobre Total]
	)

DEFINE
	VAR __SQDS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('dSeller'[Seller Name], "Frequency", 'medidas'[Frequency])

	VAR __SQDS0BodyLimited = 
		TOPN(5, __SQDS0Core, [Frequency], 0)

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('dSeller'[Seller Name], __SQDS0BodyLimited, "Frequency", 'medidas'[Frequency])

	VAR __DS0BodyLimited = 
		TOPN(1002, __DS0Core, [Frequency], 0, 'dSeller'[Seller Name], 1)

EVALUATE
	GROUPBY(
		__DS0Core,
		"MinFrequency", MINX(CURRENTGROUP(), [Frequency]),
		"MaxFrequency", MAXX(CURRENTGROUP(), [Frequency])
	)

EVALUATE
	__DS0BodyLimited

ORDER BY
	[Frequency] DESC, 'dSeller'[Seller Name]

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			ROLLUPADDISSUBTOTAL('dProduct'[product_category_name_english], "IsGrandTotalRowTotal"),
			"v__Faturamento_Format", 'medidas'[$ Faturamento Format],
			"v___Faturamento_Format_FormatString", IGNORE('medidas'[_$ Faturamento Format FormatString]),
			"Qtd_Pedidos_Total", 'medidas'[Qtd Pedidos Total]
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(
			501,
			__DS0Core,
			[IsGrandTotalRowTotal],
			1,
			[v__Faturamento_Format],
			0,
			'dProduct'[product_category_name_english],
			1
		)

	VAR __DS0CoreNoInstanceFiltersNoTotals = 
		FILTER(KEEPFILTERS(__DS0Core), [IsGrandTotalRowTotal] = FALSE)

EVALUATE
	GROUPBY(
		__DS0CoreNoInstanceFiltersNoTotals,
		"Minv__Faturamento_Format", MINX(CURRENTGROUP(), [v__Faturamento_Format]),
		"Maxv__Faturamento_Format", MAXX(CURRENTGROUP(), [v__Faturamento_Format]),
		"MinQtd_Pedidos_Total", MINX(CURRENTGROUP(), [Qtd_Pedidos_Total]),
		"MaxQtd_Pedidos_Total", MAXX(CURRENTGROUP(), [Qtd_Pedidos_Total])
	)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	[IsGrandTotalRowTotal],
	[v__Faturamento_Format] DESC,
	'dProduct'[product_category_name_english]
